messages.author: a01a26b6ad3d73df
messages.subject: Error in commonfactorGWAS (error and code "attached")
parts:
Dear Genomic SEM team,

hopefully a question with an easy solution. Unfortunately, after running for a few days the following commonfactorGWAS command threw an error message:

> load("FIonly_CogSub_COV.RData")
> load("CF_FIMeasures_sumstats1.RData")

> CommonFactor_FIMeasures_SNP <- commonfactorGWAS(covstruc = FIonly_CogSub_COV, SNPs = CF_FIMeasures_sumstats1, 
estimation = "DWLS", parallel = TRUE)

[1] "Please note that an update was made to commonfactorGWAS on 11/21/19 so that it combines addSNPs and commonfactorGWAS."
This is lavaan 0.6-7
lavaan is BETA software! Please report any bugs.

Error in data.frame(..., check.names = FALSE) : 
  arguments imply differing number of rows: 6671428, 3812244
In addition: Warning messages:
1: closing unused connection 9 (<-localhost:11016) 
2: closing unused connection 8 (<-localhost:11016) 
3: closing unused connection 7 (<-localhost:11016) 
4: closing unused connection 6 (<-localhost:11016) 
5: closing unused connection 5 (<-localhost:11016) 
6: closing unused connection 4 (<-localhost:11016) 
7: closing unused connection 3 (<-localhost:11016) 
8: In mclapply(argsList, FUN, mc.preschedule = preschedule, mc.set.seed = set.seed,  :
  scheduled cores 1, 2, 5 did not deliver results, all values of the jobs will be affected

Would you have any suggestions or solutions for this issue?

Thank you, Ulrich

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Also the other code for the preceding steps:

# LDSC
traits<- c("f4957_HM3.sumstats.gz","f4979_HM3.sumstats.gz",
           "f4990_HM3.sumstats.gz","f5001_HM3.sumstats.gz","f5012_HM3.sumstats.gz")
sample.prev <- c(NA,NA,NA,NA,NA)
population.prev <- c(NA,NA,NA,NA,NA)
ld <- "eur_w_ld_chr/"
wld <- "eur_w_ld_chr/"
trait.names<-c("WI", "FRC", "COA", "SYN", "CHA")

FIonly_CogSub_COV<-ldsc(traits=traits, sample.prev=sample.prev, 
population.prev=population.prev, ld=ld, wld=wld,trait.names=trait.names)
save(FIonly_CogSub_COV, file="FIonly_CogSub_COV.RData")

# Sumstats
files=c("f4957_sumstats.txt", "f4979_sumstats.txt", 
        "f4990_sumstats.txt","f5001_sumstats.txt", "f5012_sumstats.txt")
ref= "reference.1000G.maf.0.005.txt"
trait.names<-c("WI", "FRC", "COA", "SYN", "CHA")
se.logit=c(T,T,T,T,T)

CF_FIMeasures_sumstats1 <-sumstats(files=files,ref=ref,trait.names=trait.names,se.logit=se.logit)
save(CF_FIMeasures_sumstats1, file="CF_FIMeasures_sumstats1.RData")

messages.author: d6d83e22ef3ba9f1
messages.subject: Re: Error in commonfactorGWAS (error and code "attached")
parts:
Hi Ulrich, 

Was there a time limit on the job (I'm wondering if it just timed out?). My one suggestion would be to try subsetting the sumstats output to the first 100 SNPs and see if it produces output, because then that will tell us it has to do with run times and/or reaching memory limits. 

-Andrew

Hi Andrew,

thank you for the quick reply and recommendations, and I might try it again with fewer SNPs. 
Generally, I don't think that there is "resource limit" which should hinder the process, let's see.

Best, Ulrich
